verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch13.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, comparison figures, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, comparisons, World Bank country notes)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and country metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0)
verification.result: All 3,416 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; Cambodia's 1994 growth figure in the World Bank file (-34.8%) is not used in any sentence; unsourced wording (when Romania became high income, Ecuador's inflation 'by regional standards') was removed before publishing

changelog.note: First version: World Bank WDI figures (update of 11 November 2026).
